title: glab api projects/${project}/issues/${n}
description: One issue, ${project} the project's path URL-encoded and ${n} the issue's iid, whose assignees, state, and title kit reads in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh` (forge/gitlab:issue-assignees, forge/gitlab:issue-state, forge/gitlab:issue-title, and forge/gitlab:link-branch through it), which `modules/bash/tracker/forge.sh` (tracker/forge:state, tracker/forge:title) reaches through the forge. The types are APIEntitiesIssue of GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/issues/{issue_iid} in GitLab's REST OpenAPI, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/master/doc/api/openapi/openapi_v3.yaml, and the state's values those of https://docs.gitlab.com/api/issues/.
